KEY FACTS

Austria Tourism includes Lünersee in the Rätikon as a fishing destination.

Austria Tourism — fishing destinations ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Coordinate mountain access and fishing time before picking rod length or lure quantities. Ask about the actual shoreline route and return transport. Pack one agreed approach instead of a heavy mixed tackle collection that compromises the walk.

Protect the hiking plan first

Confirm that the particular lake and access route suit the intended fishing visit. Keep the fishing equipment compact enough that it does not displace navigation, layers, water and emergency essentials. Bank fishing does not automatically require waders.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Austria

Austria normally requires a provincial fishing card or guest card, plus permission for the chosen water. Rules differ between the nine provinces, so one province's card is not a countrywide permit.

  • 30 daysVienna guest fishing card
Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Lünersee day pass ↗ · EUR 30
    Anglers who fish the specified managed water. Buy at the cableway stations, listed tackle shop, or linked Hejfish shop.

Rules for this water

  • The 2026 season is June 27–October 26.
  • One day pass per person permits six fish.
  • Check the official rules for Lünersee / Rätikon, including water exceptions and current closures official regulations ↗
